basic_info.description: Sunny North Bayview home coming soon!  Coveted three bedrooms and 2.5 baths home on a beautiful cul-de- sac. Large garage with 2 cars side by side parking and ample driveway too. Open kitchen/LR/DR room layout with sliding doors to a large deck displaying stunning downtown and hillside views. The master suite is on the upper level with it's own deck and huge walk in closet with custom cabinets. The lower level has the other 2 BRs, a bath and plenty of closets. These BRs open to a deck and nice yard. There are solar panels, handsome wood flooring, washer and dryer, and skylights. This is a quiet court surrounded by greeneries and parks. Bayview is located near the Bay centrally located to downtown and easy access to the Peninsula. Thriving restaurants and shops along 3rd Street to Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, Chase Center and Mission Bay. Hike, bike and walk along the waterfront.
